title: Document Archive
subtitle: Official acts, procedural rulings, and expert conclusions.

documents.title: Ruling of the Arbitration Court of the Moscow Region
documents.desc: The court confirms: the sale of the land plot by JSC FEZ is entirely lawful, no damage occurred, and the price exceeds the cadastral value.

documents.title: Interpol CCF Letter — Complaint Accepted for Review
documents.desc: The Interpol Commission for the Control of Files (CCF) confirms commencement of a review of the Red Notice (ref. CCF/135/R1610.25). The defence is granted one month to submit additional materials.

documents.title: Search (Seizure) Record — LLC 'Company for Valuation and Law'
documents.desc: Record of the investigative action of 15 December 2022. Compiled by Investigator Yu.M. Salikov. Documents the seizure of CRM system data — files relating to transactions 2021/447 and 2021/3327.

documents.title: Inspection Record
documents.desc: Inspection of an optical disc containing the LLC 'Company for Valuation and Law' CRM database. Established: the appraisal company was found through an ordinary internet search; the contract was signed by General Director A.V. Panov. Contains correspondence refuting the 'conspiracy' thesis.

documents.title: Inspection Record — Telephone of Witness Sorokina I.O.
documents.desc: Inspection of HDD and iPhone 12 belonging to witness Sorokina I.O. (appraiser at LLC 'Company for Valuation and Law'). Compiled by investigation team leader Yu.M. Salikov. Contains WhatsApp correspondence between employees of the appraisal company, recorded by the investigation as evidence.

documents.title: Page-by-Page Analysis of the Charges — Defence Objections
documents.desc: Detailed examination of the charge text page by page.

documents.title: Analysis of Records: Three Episodes of Inverted Interpretation
documents.desc: The investigation quotes its own records accurately — and arrives at conclusions directly opposite to the plain meaning of the recorded phrases. Episode 1: 'the value must be real' is interpreted as a conspiracy to understate. Episode 2: a trip to collect the original report, explained in the same CRM correspondence, is declared 'illogical' and evidence of intent. Episode 3: 'sent in pdf' — a standard work message — is included in the evidence base for conspiracy.
